nonclaims: The mutation ledger executes declared rows only; it does not measure mutants nobody declared, and every mutant here is a single textual edit chosen by the author.

The lane-root gate's behavioural killer (a monkeypatched producer that raises if reached) is not in this packet; the gate's loosening is executed only through the isinstance inventory pin of the exact-ownership mechanical packet.
The Rust statement-root/occurrence condition swap has no executable killer in either language; its code-to-condition binding rests on the admission_rust_twin source pin.

In-process object.__new__ construction bypasses every __post_init__; check (0) refuses what it can re-validate, but a forged witness whose planted scalars are well-formed and mutually consistent is indistinguishable from a minted one, as for every token-gated witness on this path.
The prior fragment is bound to the journal only through its lane_state_root (STALE_JOURNAL); binding it to its own receipt is certificate-level chain continuity (C9b).

Reject-code divergence, decided: Python refuses malformed or forged inputs at check (0) by raising at the type boundary, while the Rust producer returns ACCEPTED_INVALID as a value; parity vectors cover well-formed inputs only and the Rust admission twin (C9b) will document the same split.

claimant_entitlements are caller-chosen at the producer layer: the wave-B coverage fold is keyed on (asset, control_domain) only, so claimant identity and the split across claimants are not proved by the receipt here; they are bound at the certificate layer by ENTITLEMENT_ROWS_DRIFT against the V1 liabilities partition of GlobalEconomicStateV1, a check no acceptance path reaches while ASSET_TRANSFER stays at NO_PRODUCER, and whether that partition is authoritative for asset-transfer custody is an unresolved policy question.

Exact-type gating is audited and mechanically pinned on the receipt-admission path only; the epoch-certificate verification inputs in global_economic_proof_v1 still use isinstance and are the named open gap O-008 EXACT-TYPE-AUDIT-EPOCH-PATH.
No Rust twin of the admission exists; the Rust producer validates the accepted value at its check 0 instead (open gap for C9b).
The certificate registry keeps ASSET_TRANSFER at NO_PRODUCER; no acceptance path consumes the fragment witness until C9b lands the registry flip behind a type gate.
The module witness's succinct-receipt check is inherited from lane_module_receipt_verification_v1; this candidate adds no cryptographic claims of its own.
No production, release, settlement, verifier, migration, publication, or value-moving authority is granted.
